title: Odile and the Harbor
author: Quentin Sterling
blurb: Juniper Iversen, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
